notes.title: New Trail, Tweaked Scoring & MTB Speed Adjustments – Update Now!
notes.notes:
PedalVerse just got better! Experience a fresh challenge with a new trail in Trail Roulette. We’ve also fine-tuned the scoring system and adjusted MTB speeds for smoother gameplay.

Tip: For players on high-end systems, the game may default to "Ultra" graphics settings, which could cause frame drops. To ensure smoother performance, switch to "High" settings for stable frame rates while still enjoying great visuals. Update now for the best experience!

notes.title: Graphic Settings Suggestion for Pedaleverse for smoother gameplay
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’d like to offer a suggestion to improve your experience in Pedaleverse. For players using high-end systems, the game may default to "Ultra" graphics settings. While this setting offers beautiful visuals, we’ve noticed that it can sometimes lead to frame drops.

To ensure a smoother and more consistent gameplay experience, we recommend manually switching the graphic settings to "High." The good news is that you’ll still get excellent visual quality, but with more stable frame rates and smoother gameplay.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and truly appreciate your support as we work to make Pedaleverse the best it can be.

Thanks for riding with us!

notes.title: Performance Improvements & Quality Tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In this update, we've made some adjustments to improve your overall gameplay experience:

Video Quality Adjustment: We've noticed that the "Ultra" video quality setting was causing frame drops on some high-end systems. To provide a smoother experience without compromising visual quality, we recommend changing the video quality from "Ultra" to "High". The "High" setting provides excellent visuals while ensuring stable performance.

Benchmark Update: After running benchmarks, the game was automatically selecting "Ultra" quality by default on some high-end PCs. We're making adjustments to improve the default settings for optimal balance between quality and performance.

If you experience frame drops on "Ultra," give the "High" setting a try for a smoother experience!

notes.title: Localization Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Localization has been added! We've expanded the game’s accessibility with new language options to support a broader audience. Players can now enjoy the game in additional languages, enhancing the overall experience for non-English speaking communities.

Make sure to update your game to enjoy the new features!

notes.title: Minor Fixes!
notes.notes: We’ve fixed a minor issue affecting two achievements. Enjoy a smoother experience

notes.title: Steam Achievements Now Live and Unlockable
notes.notes: We’re excited to announce that Steam Achievements are now fully functional and ready to be unlocked! Players can now earn achievements as they progress through the game, adding extra goals and rewards to enhance your gameplay experience.

notes.title: PedalVerse Launch
notes.notes:
PedalVerse is all about pushing limits, exploring freely, and embracing the thrill of MTB and FPV drone adventure. In our Trails Roulette mode, you'll face a mix of challenges and free rides on randomly selected tracks. Conquer challenges to unlock rewards for customizing your rider and MTB.

Climb to the top of our global and track-specific leaderboards, and prove you're the fastest out there!

Want a bit more freedom? Dive into our semi-open world map where you and your bike explore hidden tracks, with an FPV drone as your partner. Fly where the MTB can't, scout routes, then switch back to your bike for a blazing downhill run.

We're just getting started! More tracks and possibly even FPV drone races are coming soon to Trails Roulette. Join us on this ride—see you on the leaderboard!
